summary_zh: 今日泰國製造業焦點：汽車業在經濟不確定、地緣緊張與價格戰下加速轉向新能源車；工業聯合會支持加強工業廢棄物稽查並提出四項源頭與末端方案；調查指出高技能人才缺口約100萬人。另有汽車零組件業者嘗試進軍太空產業，顯示提升技術與高值製造的需求上升。
summary_en: Thai auto makers shift fast to EVs amid uncertainty and price wars; FTI backs tougher industrial waste inspections with four solutions; a survey finds a ~1M high-skill talent gap, worst in aviation and logistics; auto-parts firms eye the space industry, signaling higher-value manufacturing needs.
